question: Should OpenClaw support this as a post-subagent completion plugin hook, or narrow it into observation-only subagent lifecycle data plus a separate generic delivery/output boundary?
rationale: The source gap is real, but PR #56904 shows maintainers rejected a broad subagent-only guard shape, and payload exposure plus announcement mutation are public API and security-boundary choices.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the issue open and define safe subagent lifecycle metadata plus a generic delivery/output boundary with explicit redaction, timeout, ordering, and audit semantics.

options.title: Split to canonical related issues
options.body: Close or supersede this only if maintainers decide the open lifecycle, suppression, final-owner, and artifact-guard issues fully cover the remaining use cases.

options.title: Observation-only subagent event
options.body: Expose only non-mutating completion metadata now and leave enrichment, suppression, and delivery-result behavior to later delivery-policy work.

recommendation.title: Narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and define safe subagent lifecycle metadata plus a generic delivery/output boundary with explicit redaction, timeout, ordering, and audit semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent API review signal on the overlapping guard-hook PR and nearby subagent delivery design.
